title: [docs] ccp-conformance.md cites bare epic project-LICHEN-worker6-x7hh which is not a bead
description: From x7hh.13.1.1 codereview pass 1 (correctness, kimi-k3, 2026-09-09). docs/ccp-conformance.md:9 says 'Work is tracked under project-LICHEN-worker6-x7hh', but no bare x7hh epic exists in the store: bd show reports the ID ambiguous against 203 descendants (x7hh.N.M...) whose parents chain up to project-LICHEN-kudc, and .beads/issues/ has no bare x7hh json. The x7hh family is real and resolves via parent links to kudc, so the reference is de-facto followable, but the exact ID does not resolve. Scoped fix (belongs to the publication owner or the final audit x7hh.13.1.10, NOT the verbatim recovery): amend the citation to project-LICHEN-kudc or to the actual root epic once one exists. Do not edit the recovered accepted text without the publication owner.
